advisory: Consider postponing chemical spraying when rain is likely soon (>50% probability) to prevent wash-off and chemical runoff.
Hold off on supplemental irrigation for paddy fields as substantial rainfall (>60% probability) is expected, saving energy and water.
High daytime temperatures (>32°C) can cause terminal heat stress during grain development. Ensure light irrigation to maintain soil coolness.
Wind speeds exceed 25 km/h. Avoid aerial or foliar spraying on cotton crops due to drift, and stake vulnerable young plants.
Relative humidity exceeds 80%, creating conditions favorable for fungal blights in tomato. Ensure soil drainage and inspect foliage.
Postpone harvesting and field curing of onions if rain chance exceeds 45% to prevent fungal rot and storage decay.
Temperatures exceeding 35°C cause wilting in leafy vegetables. Employ mulching, shade netting, or morning micro-sprinklers.
Strong winds (>30 km/h) can cause heavy premature fruit drop in mango, banana, and citrus orchards. Prop heavy-bearing branches.
